author: Codex independent critical architecture/concurrency design; no external model

candidate.name: B-retirement permission/payload exchange
candidate.positive_action: 用已计费私有Qi保留尚未获WRITE许可的源尾段，在实际旧region全部physicalB退休后，原子把相同owned result槽从旧WRITE region换为下一WRITE region；无需旧/新WRITE的完整PA结果长期同时驻留。
state: sealed shared source AR: immutable PA/address/length/attributes plus frozen participant mask
each recipient: own READ-authorized/context/epoch obligation; original source IOVA/range remains available for invalidation matching
each WRITE region owner: cookie/generation, physical mapping, authorized logical range, true W progress, count of unsettled physicalB
private payload cursor and reserved free/committed-byte accounting; no additional payload buffer
one native successful-result scratch with actual prepResp handshake and access_ok, counted globally
algorithm: Validate every participant's complete own READ envelope; check shared PA/data/attributes compatibility and crop the common physical AR endpoint while READ results are available.

Compile only the final immutable physical AR fields into the same paid source staging. Keep the authorization/context/epoch obligation separately; do not keep duplicate full PA/range solely because logical RLAST is pending.

With actual owned continuous WRITE frontiers Fi and reserved Qi, select e<=min(Fi+Qi); freeze AR fields before first VALID. This admission condition is the previously established safety component, not a newly named independent algorithm.
Issue physical WRITE children only wholly resident and within retained own WRITE scope. Preserve the old region through all its real children/patch B obligations.
After that region's final actual B, clear the old region and accept the next successful native result into the same reusable owned slot atomically. A READY0 response VALID alone cannot enlarge Fi.
Retain the unprepared source suffix privately while native cache hit/PTW completes. Use returned owned PA through the same trusted TC route, then finish real W/B and logical completion.
candidate.fairness: No privilege is gained by retirement. Eventual real W/B and successful native preparation are required. A permanent fault/revocation needs the same failure protocol as controls; no infinite completion guarantee from capacity alone.
candidate.distinction: This moves pressure between certificate overlap and payload retention. It does not by itself create a new physical memory, beat an equivalent buffered fork, or prove an area reduction.

strongest_complete_control.name: one-full sponsor with source-stage lifetime projection and native scratch reuse
strongest_complete_control.same_budget: Same AR staging, native successful prepare/access_ok/trusted PA lookup, total physical state, old WRITE B lifetime, Qi, all own source READ rights and caches; no forced additional PTW.
steps: Sequentially receive the same own READ results, check permission and shared PA compatibility, and seal the common physical source AR inside existing paid AR staging without asserting VALID.

Keep each own authorization/context/epoch obligation and required original IOVA/range. Reuse consumed full READ PA/range fields; if a source-grant scratch is the only such field set, reuse that same scratch after all READ grants have been compiled.

Use the freed fields or counted global native scratch to receive and own one recipient's tail WRITE result. Preserve all others' initial partial regions; retain sponsor's prefix and tail mappings until their actual region Bs.
With one full sponsor and all other suffixes fitting their same Qi, assert the same source AR fields and consume the same ordered source stream through the same per-recipient acceptance mask/FIFOs.
Independently write wholly resident authorized children. Retire each old prefix result at its real finalB; accept that recipient's tail result in its freed slot with native cache reuse allowed.
Complete every physical source R, real destination W/B and original logical ACK; the source AR is neither withdrawn nor enlarged.
field_projection_obligations: A prepared physical AR address must reside in paid staging, not disappear when original READ PA fields are reused.

READ-authorized bits alone are insufficient if original virtual address/range, DID/PID, privilege, context generation or invalidation routing must still be matched. Retain those fields, using original descriptors only when their real lifetime covers the obligation.
The scratch cannot be overwritten while its sponsor WRITE mapping is still needed. If future overlapping cold preparations need it, their real waiting/capacity cost must be counted.
Preparation acceptance and mapping ownership must be explicit; do not use unaccepted VALID as a free certificate.
Same IOTLB hit/ref lookup is permitted for controls; no manufactured cache eviction/PTW penalty.
strongest_complete_control.why_not_speculative_addition: This is a complete stage-lifetime control with field ownership and release points, not a claim that an ordinary method could add the entire candidate. It uses the shared interfaces already charged to both methods.
strongest_complete_control.outcome: A K+1 peak count of distinct live WRITE regions can fit in the same total hardware through consumed READ fields or an existing globally routeable result scratch. Thus peak WRITE count alone does not prove extra storage/LUT.

positive.initial: K2, sourceN8, owned prefixF_A5/F_B6, Qi3/3. Prefix/tail mappings have distinct noncontiguous PAs; one affine PA/range cannot silently encode both.
event_accounting: Receive/write A and B's authorized prefix chunks under the same private capacity. With maximum fully resident child3, A prefix children3+2 and B prefix3+3 suffice.
A unprepared suffix3 and B suffix2 fit their private buffers, so the single source AR can deliver RLAST before either next-WRITE preparation is needed.
After each old prefix's actual finalB, its slot can receive its tail result. Tail WRITE childrenA3/B2 then finish. Total physical dataR8/W16; sourceAR1; perrecipient physicalAW/B3; null0.
No timed cycles or ACK advantage are asserted. The event sequence assumes eventual independent resident-prefix write service and successful preparation.
positive.proven_resource_characterization: The all-partial action can avoid overlap of old and new full WRITE-mapping records within each private per-flow region store by retaining tail payload. This is a valid lifetime/resource tradeoff.
positive.conditional_slot_witness: If all globally usable certificate fields and scratch slots really are occupied by still-live unrelated obligations, and no consumed READ PA/range field is available, one-full sponsor cannot acquire an extra tail mapping before AR. The candidate may still launch this legal AR with only prefixes and reserved tails. This is a conditional saturated-state capability, not a demonstrated production state or minimum static-storage theorem.
positive.ordinary_limit: A same-budget shared split can launch a prepared-prefix AR before waiting for tail results and then the remaining AR. It can complete with the same private result slots; it does not reproduce the exact one-source-AR action.
positive.unknown: No current source evidence proves the stated total saturation is reachable after source-stage projection. Do not send this conditional resource witness into a model/RTL yet.

neighbor.initial: Same geometry, but one counted global native scratch or a consumed READ PA/range field is available after AR sealing.
neighbor.result: The complete projected one-full sponsor accepts its tail there, then issues sourceAR1 with the same Qi and overall physical storage. The earlier K-versus-K+1 area argument fails.
neighbor.extra_neighbor: If N9 withF_A5 andQi3, all-partial long admission is unsafe in the restricted serialized-return contract even if its permission records are compact. Need source split/full authorization/another counted return slot.
neighbor.no_hidden_speed_claim: Two ARs can finish earlier than one maximal safe AR; source setup cost and tail-prepare service must be measured. The lifetime rule is not a universal fastest endpoint selector.

cost_and_lower_bound.invalidated_claim: 撤销‘K私有WRITE槽而full sponsor需K+1，因此必需增加物理存储’。所有TL/PTW临时PA、global result scratch、AR staging、TC saved mapping和consumed READ字段都计入总硬件；可合法成为owned/routeable结果的位置不能被人造排除。
cost_and_lower_bound.surviving_bound: Distinct simultaneously usable WRITE regions may peak atK+1 for the sponsor versusK under deferred replacement, but this is a live-region count, not a universal minimum-total-bit theorem.
cost_and_lower_bound.readonly_projection: Successful own READ authorization lifetime and full PA representation lifetime are separate. Physical source AR staging already embodies the copied PA once scope is fixed; own READ context/epoch obligations survive independently.
additional_candidate_cost: per-region real physicalB debt count/cookie generation, including all children rather than firstB
atomic replace/access_ok/result-owner routing and invalidation checks
reserved suffix payload already in Qi, plus its extended residency/opportunity cost
no free AR sealing register if platform lacks a legal non-VALID staging state
cost_and_lower_bound.actual_unpriced: The initial S-only stable mapping interface is proposed; exact field reclamation, global scratch ownership and invalidation/epoch encoding are not yet source-closed. No silicon area or LUT saving is measured.

decision.result: REDesign resource novelty claim; retain B-retirement exchange and READ stage projection as shared architecture components.
decision.why: Because the complete ordinary projected sponsor can use freed full READ fields or counted common scratch, the finite example does not prove a smaller minimum total storage requirement or unique oneAR performance at the accepted whole-system budget.
decision.could_be_contribution_if: 如果源AR已封存后仍存在真实可达的总许可状态饱和，而all-partial/B退休交换在相同状态与数据预算下保证普通强控制不能完成的有用动作，或同时减少实测许可驻留/其它PTW阻塞且没有额外payload/控制代价抵消，就可以把这项资源能力作为贡献。必须先核实际饱和/字段与失效义务，而不是强制READ完整PA持有到RLAST。
decision.unique_next_question: After the same source AR is sealed, which exact physical fields remain required for own READ context/epoch/invalidation obligations, and which exact result/scratch fields are legally reusable for a sponsor tail? If at least one complete tail fits and remains independently routeable, stop the proposed storage-advantage experiment.
decision.stop: No new model, prior scan, RTL or documentation maintenance from this seat.
